title: Where Is It on the Hype Cycle?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Place eight events from the history of educational technology on the five stages of the hype cycle.

educational.topic: Where Is It on the Hype Cycle?
learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight events in the history of educational technology by the stage of the hype cycle they illustrate, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The five stages of the hype cycle and EdTech hype waves, from the section "The Hype Cycle and Educational Technology" in Chapter 15.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: A district announces a plan to give every student a tablet. Which stage?
Does the trough mean a technology has failed?
commonMisconceptions: The trough means a technology has failed
The peak is when a technology is most useful
Every technology follows the cycle exactly
assessmentOpportunities: A district announces a plan to give every student a tablet. Which stage?
Does the trough mean a technology has failed?
Randomized studies show which uses of an AI tutor help and which harm. Which stage?
Is the peak the moment a technology is most useful?

controls.name: 5 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the stages; two tries per event.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the stages and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
